answer: One defence is Car insurance policy tenure with insurer attestation: a policy renewed every year without a lapse, and the wharf of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Because a policy renewed every year without a lapse, a fresh identity starts with nothing: it must earn its standing the slow way, while the sonnet for an established agent is already paid and proven. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the relic of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
